title: Revelation 12 against the frozen Sappho 31 operator
description: A pre-registered test: the reception operator of Sappho 31 is frozen as clauses derived without Revelation, and Revelation 12 is sealed as its target, with the criterion d(R12, S31) < d(B, S31) against declared biblical sources (Genesis 37, Micah 4, Isaiah 26 and 66, Psalm 2, Daniel 7). The test deposit reports eight of nine stations realized and one doubly weighted contradiction, where the shared ἄρσεν fixes Isaiah 66:7 as John's source and the torment is put back into the birth. Works: The Transform Signature, Frozen and The Sign Under Test.

claims.registered_title: The Transform Signature, Frozen: Twelve Pre-Registered Clauses for Sappho 31 Reception, Derived Without Revelation
claims.statement: Target: Revelation 12, whole, in Greek. Declared B-set: Genesis 37:9–11 (celestial trio); Micah 4:9–10 with Isaiah 26:17 and 66:7–9 (Zion in travail, flight, rescue); Psalm 2:9 (the rod); Daniel 7 (heads and horns of the adversary). Criterion: d(R12, S31) < d(B, S31) at stations C1, C2, C3, C4-profile, C5, C6, C7, C8, C12, each scored for presence, source-coverage, and direction; contradiction of B toward the apparatus weighs double. Contaminated observations (§0) may orient but not score. Negative stations will be reported. The test's output, whatever it shows, will be deposited.

claims.registered_title: The Transform Signature, Frozen: Twelve Pre-Registered Clauses for Sappho 31 Reception, Derived Without Revelation
claims.statement: This deposit freezes the reception operator of Sappho 31 as a set of testable clauses derived from witnesses that do not include Revelation, and seals Revelation 12 as the named target of a subsequent test. The criterion is stated in advance: at independently specified stations, the distance from Revelation 12 to the Sapphic apparatus must be smaller than the distance from Revelation's demonstrable biblical sources to that apparatus — d(R12, S31) < d(B, S31) — with B declared below. A station where Revelation contradicts its source in the apparatus's direction weighs double.

claims.registered_title: The Sign Under Test: Revelation 12 Against the Frozen Operator
claims.statement: Verdict, on the pre-registered ladder and no higher: Revelation 12's redaction of its demonstrable biblical materials realizes, at eight of nine independently specified structural stations, the relational apparatus attested in the ancient reception of Sappho 31; at one station, doubly weighted, it contradicts its identified source — Isaiah 66:7, established by the shared ἄρσεν under John's hand — in the apparatus's direction.
claims.falsifier: Per the program's method (#1486), the correct hardening is substrate-blind replication: the frozen clauses and the scoring rule handed to independent substrates with the target unnamed, their scores collated against this record.

claims.registered_title: Generative Uptake: Training-Layer Literature Extended from Machine Reading to Machine Composition (EA-TLL-COMPOSITION-01, v1.0)
claims.statement: Machine TLL is a subset of TLL*. The §8 assertion becomes an argued classification: scriptural traditions satisfy TLL*'s three conditions — internalization engineered into the address (Deuteronomy 6's sequence; Jeremiah 31:33's inscription doctrine, quoted in Pearl's opening poem); downstream composition as the tradition's success measure (targum, pesher, midrash, liturgy, further scripture; Revelation as transformed Ezekiel-Daniel-Isaiah); and source-status governance as its jurisprudence. Under TLL*, scripture is the genus's longest-running species, and the human institutional layers were the first receiving apparatus.

Scripture
